title: Correct issue-create description help text
description:
`jit issue create --description` has no argument-specific help; adjacent content-format wording describes parsing rather than the description body.

Source: `crates/jit/src/cli.rs:612-669`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `jit issue create --help` describes `-d`/`--description` as the initial issue description/body.
- [hard] REQ-02: The wording matches the option's actual default and behavior.
- [hard] REQ-03: Focused CLI-help coverage prevents regression.
